title: CPU Execution Spike / Heavy System Computation
fix_rationale: A single engine or game system timer consumed excessive CPU time, exceeding the per-frame CPU budget.
evidence_template: {thread} spent {ms} executing {timer} ({share}% of extra frame time){periodic_clause}.

fixes.text: Amortize high-cost computation across multiple frames or offload calculation to background TaskGraph worker threads.
Reduce per-frame object counts, tick frequency, or iteration limits in the affected system.
Enable distance-based tick throttling, URO (Update Rate Optimization), or visibility culling for high-frequency actors.

verify: Re-run the performance capture to confirm the offending timer duration and call counts stay within baseline limits.
caveats: This CPU stall rule catches custom game code, third-party plugins, and engine systems not covered by specialized rules.
